caveats: Baseline contains real failing contracts/behaviors, not a green suite.
Only changed pass/fail membership is established for asynchronous cases; exact nondeterminism/race causes are not proven.
The CUDA embedding test uses mocked transfer and cannot be excused as missing GPU.
CUDA/CPU execution-budget tests contain 16000 byte total-RAM fixture despite 16 GiB available RAM; actual runtime resource exhaustion is not the observed cause.
Historical run environment/package versions overlap, but not every external/timing condition is identical.
